knimeNode.name: Evaluation
knimeNode.shortDescription: Evaluates candidates with a benchmark, formulas, or result columns created upstream.

fullDescription.intro: Choose a built-in benchmark, write formulas for a custom problem, or use objective and constraint-result columns already produced by Python, ML, simulations, databases, or other KNIME nodes. Required formula cards are generated from Problem Setup and separated into objective and constraint sections. Built-in benchmarks calculate their objectives automatically and expose only formulas for declared constraint results. Binary-encoded numerical groups are decoded automatically. Every method validates results, calculates constraint violations, advances NFE, and creates evaluation-history events.

ports.inPort: The same setup used to initialize the population.
ports.outPort: Validated candidates with objectives, constraints, and evaluation counters.
One event per newly evaluated candidate.
